orientation_reassessment.prior_limitation: The first pass did not systematically test 180-degree alternatives. Later global-rotation commentary was premature and corrected.
orientation_reassessment.cut10: 180-degree rotation remains an unverified proposed comparison transform. Independent reader compared C.10a.1/C.10.1 with UC15245201 native/180 displays: clipped ends, narrow curved visible faces and nonunique contour/puncture correspondences prevent determining orientation or physical side. Left margin/right lettering alone cannot discriminate viewing rotation or another face. IV2 and adjacent Hebrew remain unregistered.
orientation_reassessment.other_cuts: Readers revisited 13 BW cuts1–4 and 12 BW cuts7–8 with explicit 180-degree alternatives. These do not justify applying cut10 rotation globally; cut7/8 landmarks favor native orientation. Card position alone is not a text-axis datum.
orientation_reassessment.transforms: View-only rotations are exploratory aids; no transformed source image or target ROI published.
